heading.title: The poetry of exact degrees
heading.subtitle: Every zodiac degree carries a symbolic image — a vignette that translates celestial position into evocative, esoteric meaning. Choose a sign and reveal its oracles.

Aries.symbol: A woman rises out of the water, a seal is embracing her.
Aries.interpretation: The emergence of new consciousness from the depths of the collective unconscious. A moment of pure becoming.

Aries.symbol: An Indian weaving a blanket in the sunlight.
Aries.interpretation: The patient, devoted crafting of one's life as art. Each thread is a choice, each pattern a story.

Aries.symbol: A duck pond and its brood.
Aries.interpretation: The quiet contentment of simple, natural belonging. Trust the rhythm of ordinary life.

Taurus.symbol: A clear mountain stream flows through a rocky gorge.
Taurus.interpretation: The pure, uncontaminated flow of life force through natural channels. Let the energy find its own path.

Taurus.symbol: A man with a rakish silk hat muffled against the cold.
Taurus.interpretation: The coexistence of elegance and necessity. Beauty persists even in harsh conditions.

Taurus.symbol: A peacock parading in an ancient garden.
Taurus.interpretation: The glorification of individuality within a tradition. Show your colors — the garden was made for this.

Gemini.symbol: A glass-bottomed boat reveals undersea wonders.
Gemini.interpretation: The capacity to see into hidden depths while staying afloat. Conscious observation of the unconscious.

Gemini.symbol: Two Dutch children talking together, exchanging what they know.
Gemini.interpretation: The joy of shared learning. Knowledge multiplies when it is given freely.

Gemini.symbol: Bathing beauties before a swimming contest.
Gemini.interpretation: The playful celebration of form and vitality. Competition as ritual, not war.

Cancer.symbol: On a ship, sailors lower an old flag and raise a new one.
Cancer.interpretation: A conscious change of allegiance. The self chooses a new loyalty — and acts on it.

Cancer.symbol: A group of rabbits dressed in clothes and on parade.
Cancer.interpretation: The playful domestication of wild instincts. Civilization as a costume over nature.

Cancer.symbol: A daughter of the American Revolution.
Cancer.interpretation: The pride of lineage and the weight of inherited values. Honor the past; don't be imprisoned by it.

Leo.symbol: A blood-red sunset, the light of the coming night.
Leo.interpretation: The passing of a cycle and the anticipation of what is to come. Every ending carries a new beginning.

Leo.symbol: A street pageant moving along a street filled with cheering people.
Leo.interpretation: The communal celebration of individual expression. The crowd needs the performer, and vice versa.
The message that has not yet been read. Potential communication — the future is still open.

Virgo.symbol: A man's head is revealed, a well-shaped head, with a look of self-confidence.
Virgo.interpretation: The self-aware, self-possessed individual. Confidence born from knowing oneself.

Virgo.symbol: A fine lace handkerchief, a heirloom.
Virgo.interpretation: The beauty of inherited refinement. Small, delicate things carry the weight of generations.

Virgo.symbol: Having an urgent task to complete, a man does not look back to anything.
Virgo.interpretation: Total commitment to the present task. The past is released; the future is served through now.

Libra.symbol: A butterfly made perfect by a dart through it.
Libra.interpretation: The beauty that comes through sacrifice. The pin that preserves also stills — choose what you fix.

Libra.symbol: Two men are placed under arrest for breaking the rules.
Libra.interpretation: The consequences of violating the social contract. Justice restores balance — but at a cost.

Libra.symbol: Three mounds of knowledge on a philosopher's head.
Libra.interpretation: The threefold nature of wisdom — intellectual, emotional, and instinctual. All three are needed.

Scorpio.symbol: A sightseeing bus is threading its way through a crowded city.
Scorpio.interpretation: The observer moving through intensity. You can witness without being consumed.

Scorpio.symbol: In a treasure room, a child is examining a miniature of a mummy.
Scorpio.interpretation: The fascination with death and what it preserves. The child studies what the adult fears.

Scorpio.symbol: The Halloween jester is merry-making for all.
Scorpio.interpretation: The sacred fool — the one who mocks death and therefore transcends it. Laughter is a portal.

Sagittarius.symbol: Retired army veterans gather to rekindle old memories.
Sagittarius.interpretation: The community of shared experience. Old battles become stories — stories become bonds.

Sagittarius.symbol: The groundhog looking for its shadow on Groundhog Day.
Sagittarius.interpretation: The search for signs and the willingness to predict. We look to nature for permission to hope.

Sagittarius.symbol: The Pope, holding the staff of office, blesses the faithful.
Sagittarius.interpretation: The bestowal of spiritual authority. The highest Sagittarian act: to bless what has been earned.

Capricorn.symbol: An Indian chief claims power from the assembled tribe.
Capricorn.interpretation: The conscious assumption of authority. Power is given by the group, not taken.

Capricorn.symbol: In a hospital, the children's ward is filled with toys.
Capricorn.interpretation: The healing power of play. Even in the most serious places, joy is medicine.

Capricorn.symbol: A secret meeting of men in a council of state.
Capricorn.interpretation: The hidden machinery of power. What is decided in private shapes the public world.

Aquarius.symbol: An old adobe mission in California, in a valley surrounded by mountains.
Aquarius.interpretation: The enduring spirit within tradition. The old structure holds the new vision.

Aquarius.symbol: Two lovebirds sitting on a fence.
Aquarius.interpretation: The delicate balance of freedom and belonging. Love that respects the boundary.

Aquarius.symbol: Deeply rooted in the past of a venerable tree, a man is able to express his spirit in a piece of wood.
Aquarius.interpretation: The transformation of raw material into spirit-made-visible. The craftsperson as channel.

Pisces.symbol: A vast public market, throngs of men, women, and children.
Pisces.interpretation: The ocean of humanity — the collective as a living body. You are a wave, not separate from the sea.

Pisces.symbol: An officer in dull dress drilling his men.
Pisces.interpretation: The discipline required to serve the collective. Order prepares the soul for transcendence.

Pisces.symbol: A giant rock jutting from the ocean, a great archway, the portal of the Seth.
Pisces.interpretation: The great transition — the portal between worlds. The end of the cycle is the gateway to the new.
